newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean Daewoo Motor eats into rivals' market.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean Daewoo Motor eats into rivals' market.

text.p: Daewoo Motor Co Ltd, a unit of South Korea's Daewoo Group, reported a 16.4 percent rise in domestic vehicle sales in March after recently launching new models, company officials said.
Daewoo sold 27,519 vehicles in March in South Korea against 23,649 units a year earlier.

Hyundai Motor Co Ltd, South Korea's largest carmaker, said its domestic vehicle sales dropped 16.2 percent to 50,382 units in March from 60,101 a year earlier, while Kia Motors Corp said its local sales fell 19.5 percent to 28,378 units in the month.
Hyundai and Kia officials said the fall in their domestic sales was due largely to a slowing economy and Daewoo's introduction of new compact car models.
Daewoo began selling Lanos compact cars last November and a larger model Nubira from February.
Nubira was the best selling car in South Korea last month when 11,723 units were sold. Lanos' March sales totalled 4,662 units.
Local sales of Hyundai's comnpact cars Accent and Avante and Kia's Avella and Sephia models were badly hit by Daewoo's new models, Hyundai and Kia officials said.
Hyundai said sales of Accent in the domestic market fell to 7,524 units in March from 8,358 units a year ago and Avante sales dropped to 9,988 units from 14,932 units.
Kia's Avella sales in the local market plunged to 1,227 units in March from 2,719 units a year before, while Sephia fell to 4,834 units from 7,806 units, a Kia spokesman said.
Hyundai's total vehicle sales in March fell 7.6 percent to 101,957 units from 110,329 units in the same month last year.
Its exports rose 2.7 percent to 51,575 units in the month from 50,228 units a year ago, Hyundai said.
Kia said its total sales totalled 68,385 units in March, up 11.6 percent from a year erlier. Kia exports soared 53.6 percent to 40,007 units in March against 26,038 units a year ago.
"We focused more on exports in March because of a slump in domestic sales," a Kia spokesman said.
Daewoo Motor's total vehicle sales in March rose 13.5 percent to 61,899 units from 54,522 a year earlier, while exports rose 11.4 percent to 34,380 units from 30,873 units.
